questions.text: A set X has 5 elements; find the number of proper subsets of X. Ans A). 25 B). 64 C). 31 D). 32 Correct Answer: C
The product of two consecutive positive natural numbers is 156. The greater of the two numbers is: Ans A). 23 B). 27 C). 7 D). 13 Correct Answer: D

In a survey of 3125 people, 863 like tea and 2561 like coffee. The minimum number of people who like both tea and coffee, given that each of the surveyed people like at least one drink between tea and coffee, is: Ans A). 308 B). 294 C). 305 D). 299 Correct Answer: D

If the highest salary ( 200,000) is removed, what will be the difference between the new range and the original range? Ans A). 170 (in ₹1,000) B). 60 (in ₹1,000) C). 80 (in ₹1,000) D). 140 (in ₹1,000) Correct Answer: D

Ram and Shyam are two candidates seeking admission to a coaching institute. Assume that their selections are independent.
